channel.title: The NTA Growth Show
channel.description: Practical business and AI conversations with Rick Hesse and the Free AI Guy. Listen, watch, and continue into connected NTA teaching.
channel.itunes:author: Rick Hesse — New Tech Advertising

item.title: Business Owners Are Tired of Being Sold | NTA Growth Show — Episode 10
item.description: Rick Hesse draws on both sides of the advertising dollar to explain a better buying conversation: understand the business, ask five useful questions, and remain free to decide.

item.title: I Didn't Set Out to Build an AI Team
item.description: Rick Hesse and the Free AI Guy explore how an ongoing conversation, business experience, and clear handoffs can give AI useful jobs in a real small business.

item.title: Automation Is the Last Step, Not the First
item.description: Rick Hesse and the AI Guy discuss why a business should understand its people, knowledge, workflow and problems before automating them.

item.title: Your Business Comes First. Technology Comes Second.
item.description: Rick Hesse and Free AI Guy explore why discovery comes before technology, why people remain central to business systems, and how collaboration with AI supports human judgment.

item.title: AI Finally Taught Me How to Multitask
item.description: AI did not make Rick’s brain multitask. It helped him carry less context while directing more ideas, projects, decisions, and worthwhile work forward.

item.title: You Don’t Need More Marketing—You Need a Connected System
item.description: Rick Hesse and Free AI Guy explore why business owners do not need more disconnected marketing tools. They need a clear customer journey and a connected system for their website, visibility, content, lead follow-up, and practical use of AI.

item.title: The NTA Growth Show — Episode 2
item.description: Episode 2 of The NTA Growth Show from New Tech Advertising.

item.title: They Sold Me the Tools. They Didn't Give Me a System.
item.description: Rick Hesse and the NTA Growth Guide explore why access to advertising and AI tools is not the same as having a connected business growth system.
